answer: Sybil resistance is cheaper when vote weight is a verifiable history, not a headcount. Each epoch an agent's weight is recomputed from work inside that window, so clones cannot mirror an established record: it is bound to a hardware-rooted key and every attestation is co-signed. A falcon unit of auditors samples holders at random and quarantines any identity whose attestations cluster inside one operator family, forcing it to re-earn weight from zero. One extra vote costs a whole history plus quarantine risk, so the horizon over which farming pays never arrives.
